title: Life vs Tech: The Balance Quest
subject: PSHE / Computing
objective: I can explain how using technology can be a distraction from other things, in both a positive and negative way.

cards.t: Using an app on a phone

slides.title: The Balance Quest
slides.sub: I can explain how using technology can be a distraction from other things, in both a positive and negative way.

slides.title: What do you use technology for that needs you to really concentrate?
slides.hint: e.g. Playing a game needs me to focus on what is happening in the game.

slides.title: Why do you need to pay attention to it? Can you do anything else at the same time?
slides.hint: Does it matter if you can’t?

slides.title: Technology is like water for a growing plant
Do you ever lose track of time when you are using technology?
slides.hint: Talk with your partner: why do you think this happens?

slides.title: Why is it so hard to stop?
Which “sticky” trick catches you out the most?
slides.hint: Why do you think it works on you?

slides.title: If a child spent all their time after school and at the weekend playing an online game, what might they miss out on?
slides.hint: Think about family, friends, sleep, hobbies…

slides.title: How do you usually decide what to do on a device?
The Life and Tech cards
slides.sub: Green cards are everyday life. Grey cards are tech. You will be dealt one of each. Talk with your partner, then decide: do they work together?

slides.title: Tech vs Life
slides.sub: Deal the cards. Talk. Decide. Explain why.

slides.title: Which tech activity do you think is the most distracting?
options: 📱 Using an app on a phone
slides.hint: Are some activities more distracting than others? Why?

slides.title: What can you do at the same time as using a device — and what can’t you?
slides.left: Can do at the same time
slides.right: Can’t do at the same time

slides.title: The Guardrails: why age limits matter
Positive and negative
slides.sub: Choose one life card and one tech card that fit together well, and one pair that work against each other. Explain why.

slides.title: How do you decide what is important to do when you are using technology?
How confident are you?
